description: This Java class 'UtilValidate' provides a comprehensive set of utility methods for validating various types of input data, including strings, numbers, dates, email addresses, URLs, and credit card numbers. It also includes functions for checking emptiness, stripping characters, and validating specific formats like SSNs, ZIP codes, and phone numbers within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilValidate
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for validating input data such as strings, numbers, dates, emails, URLs, and credit card numbers within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: isEmpty

methods.name: isNotEmpty
